summary: Teach, tailor and take control with the C-suite: insight, value, answer first, business case.

skills.label: Commercial insight
skills.definition: Reframe the problem with an insight the buyer had not considered, backed by a number.
skills.evidence: The buyer reacts to the reframe as new.

talk_track.move: Lead with an insight that reframes their problem.
talk_track.strong: Teams like yours lose more to manual review than to the errors it catches. Here is the number.
talk_track.weak: We are seeing a lot of interest in AI across your industry. Let me share some trends.
talk_track.proof: Buyer reacts to the reframe, for example “we have never measured that”

rep.buyer_line: We think our process is pretty good already.
rep.off_move: Our platform covers that end to end. Let me show you the three features customers use most.

replies.elite: That is not how we have looked at it. Show me the number.
replies.weak: We read the same analyst reports. Tell me something about us I do not already know.
replies.trap: Three features is still a pitch. I do not know why we should change anything.

curveball.speaker: Board member
curveball.line: Everyone is talking about AI. What do you know that we do not?
curveball.elite: That most of your peers measure accuracy, and lose more to the review work around it. Here is that cost.
curveball.weak: AI adoption is accelerating fast. Companies that wait risk falling behind.
curveball.trap: Our models are the most advanced on the market. Let me show you the benchmarks.

skills.label: Value messaging
skills.definition: Before and after, positive outcomes and proof, in the buyer’s terms.
skills.evidence: The buyer repeats the outcome in their own words.

talk_track.move: State before, after, and proof from a similar customer.
talk_track.strong: Today, four hours per case. After, twenty minutes, proven with a customer your size.
talk_track.weak: We help teams like yours work smarter and move faster with AI.
talk_track.proof: Buyer repeats the outcome in their words

rep.buyer_line: Why should I care about another AI tool?
rep.off_move: Because we are rated a leader by the top analyst firms this year.

replies.elite: If that holds up on our data, it is worth a closer look.
replies.weak: Every vendor in my inbox says that. What changes for my team?
replies.trap: An analyst rating is not a reason. What would change for us?

curveball.speaker: CEO
curveball.line: In one sentence, what changes for us?
curveball.elite: The work that takes your team a week today takes a day, proven at a company your size.
curveball.weak: You get an AI platform that makes your whole operation smarter.
curveball.trap: You get the most advanced AI on the market, with every feature included.

skills.label: Answer first
skills.definition: Give the recommendation first, then three supporting reasons.
skills.evidence: The executive engages with the recommendation.

talk_track.move: Lead with the answer, then the reasons.
talk_track.strong: My recommendation: start with your highest-volume workflow. Three reasons.
talk_track.weak: Of course. Let me quickly frame the context, then get to the recommendation.

rep.buyer_line: I have five minutes. What should I do?
rep.off_move: There are a few options. Let me walk you through the pros and cons of each.

replies.elite: Go ahead. Give me the three.
replies.weak: Skip the context. What do you recommend?
replies.trap: I do not have time for options. What is your recommendation?

curveball.speaker: CEO
curveball.line: I read your proposal. Too long. What is the decision you need from me?
curveball.elite: Approve a four-week proof on one workflow, with a go or no-go on the numbers. That is it.
curveball.weak: Let me take you through the key sections so the context is clear.
curveball.trap: There are a few decisions. Let me walk you through each option.

skills.label: Business case
skills.definition: A multi-year ROI and the cost of waiting that finance accepts.
skills.evidence: Finance accepts the inputs and the method.

talk_track.move: Show multi-year ROI and the cost of a year’s delay, from their inputs.
talk_track.strong: Using your numbers, three-year ROI is 4x, and the cost of waiting a year is about 2 million dollars.
talk_track.weak: Most customers see payback inside the first year.
talk_track.proof: Finance accepts the inputs and the method

rep.buyer_line: Finance will ask why we should spend this now.
rep.off_move: If you sign this quarter, I can hold the current pricing for you.

replies.elite: The cost of waiting is the line finance will react to. Send me the model behind it.
replies.weak: Most customers are not us. Finance will need our own numbers.
replies.trap: A pricing deadline is your problem, not a reason for us to buy.

curveball.speaker: CFO
curveball.line: Every project on my desk says it pays back. Why does yours go first?
curveball.elite: Because the cost of waiting is the biggest: using your volumes, each quarter of delay costs about this much.
curveball.weak: Our payback is under a year, which is faster than most projects.
curveball.trap: Because our pricing goes up next quarter, so waiting costs you more.
